div.p:
Solid arrow: association (holds a reference / field)
Dashed arrow: dependency (uses or starts)
Hollow diamond: aggregation (holds a list of)
Dashed + hollow triangle: implements
Dashed line with open arrow/diamond: planned relationship (not in code)
Dashed box: planned class (kept from original UML)
«composable» = top-level @Composable function
«Activity» = extends ComponentActivity
«object» = Kotlin singleton
